# Toronto housing portfolio case study

Prepared from the shared project chat and the existing cleaned 2011 neighbourhood table. Includes a 140-neighbourhood map, an interactive native-tooltip dot chart, illustrated budgets, the Regent Park–South Parkdale comparison, the project process, limitations and the original presentation.

Open index.html to review. A static server can also serve this directory.

## Evidence

Source: supplied City of Toronto neighbourhood Census/NHS project files. 2011 household income refers to 2010 before-tax income. Average rental housing costs include applicable utilities. Neighbourhood-level associations are not causal evidence or individual renter budgets.

Reference review included William Le, Bao To, Guo Chen and Rachel Chen. The draft uses clear project context, visual evidence and short finding-led sections while keeping the Toronto project's own analysis.
